summary.lv: Intrum Global Technologies meklē Senior Application Specialist – Workday, kurš nodrošinās Workday platformas darbību, konfigurāciju un uzlabošanu finanšu un citās biznesa jomās.
summary.en: Intrum Global Technologies is seeking a Senior Application Specialist to ensure stable operation, configuration, and continuous improvement of the Workday platform across Finance and other business areas.
